A fix for Update now when the program runs as the Windows SYSTEM account.

### What's changed
- **Update now works when the program runs as the SYSTEM account.** Before, the update downloaded and the program closed, but the setup couldn't start from SYSTEM's folder inside Windows, so nothing was installed. Updates are now saved in SYSTEM's temporary folder instead, and any setups left behind by earlier tries are cleared away. Nothing changes for anyone running the program the usual way.

Existing installs keep all their templates, clients, people and settings.

### Updating
An administrator will see **Version 3.0.16 is available** at the top of the program — choose **Update now**. Or download the setup below and run it over the top.

### New install
Download **ID-Card-Printing-Software-Free-Setup-3.0.16.exe** below and run it. The setup isn't code-signed, so the first time Windows may show *Windows protected your PC*: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, then **Yes**.
